title: build-api
responsibility: Builds the public API bundles, their declarations and the shipped kernel artifacts.

errors.name: ApiDeclarationBuildError
errors.description: Thrown with 'Public API declarations failed.' when the tsc declaration build exits non-zero.

errors.name: PublicApiBundleBuildError
errors.description: Thrown when the public API Bun.build call reports failure; the message includes the build logs.

errors.name: EdgeBundleBuildError
errors.description: Thrown when an edge Bun.build call reports failure; the message names the entry and includes the build logs.

errors.name: EdgeBundlePortabilityError
errors.description: Thrown when a built edge bundle has a from clause naming a node: or bun specifier or contains a require() call.

errors.name: API build input or output filesystem failure
errors.description: Uncaught filesystem rejections, such as a missing package.json or target/kernel/impact-kernel.wasm, also make the script fail, while a failed copy of specification/measurements/impact-kernel is ignored.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse at startup when package.json in the working directory is not valid JSON, before the --types-only check, so neither build mode runs.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown at startup when package.json is the JSON value null, and in the full build (not --types-only) when its dependencies key is missing or null, because Object.keys(dependencies) runs for the verification entry.
